welcome.title: Welcome to the admin area
welcome.body: This is where the club runs its website: events, forms, photos, finance and more. This short guide shows you around.

nav.title: Your sections
nav.body: The menu only shows the sections you are allowed to use. Need another one? Ask an admin.

cards.title: Shortcuts
cards.body: Each card opens one of your sections, with a quick reminder of what it is for.

noAccess.title: No section yet
noAccess.body: Your account is active but no section has been given to you. An admin can add one from the Accounts page.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Your email, your role (admin or member) and your department.

guide.title: Need help later?
guide.body: Every admin page has its own guide. Click this button any time to see it again.

new.title: Create an event
new.body: Start a new event here. You only need a title; everything else can be filled in later.

filters.title: Find an event
filters.body: Search by name and filter by status, past or upcoming, and year.

item.title: An event
item.body: Click it to edit. The buttons on the right let you view, duplicate or delete it.

star.title: Feature an event
star.body: The star puts the event on the home page and at the top of the Events page.

featured.title: Featured order
featured.body: Drag the featured events (or use the arrows) to choose the order visitors see them in.

pageSettings.title: The Events page
pageSettings.body: Change the title, introduction and layout of the public Events page.

tabs.title: Four tabs
tabs.body: Details, Photos & videos, Content and Design: each tab edits one part of the event page.

publish.title: Preview and publish
publish.body: Preview the page, then publish it when it is ready. Until then, visitors can't see it.

general.title: The basics
general.body: Title, date, place and short description, in French and English.

cover.title: Cover photo
cover.body: The image shown on the event card and at the top of its page.

stats.title: Key numbers
stats.body: Add numbers like participants or people trained. They appear on the event page.

registration.title: Registration
registration.body: Link a sign-up form or an external link so people can register.

save.title: Save your changes
save.body: This bar tells you when something isn't saved yet. Click Save before leaving.

upload.title: Add photos and videos
upload.body: Drop files here or click to choose them. They are added to the event gallery.

item.title: A gallery item
item.body: Add a description for accessibility, use it as the cover, or delete it.

languages.title: French and English
languages.body: Write the page in French, then switch to English. An empty English page can be copied from the French one.

toolbar.title: Formatting tools
toolbar.body: Titles, bold, lists, links, images and more. The + button inserts blocks like photos or videos.

status.title: Saved automatically
status.body: Your text is saved as you type. This shows the word count and the last save.

controls.title: Colors and style
controls.body: Pick a ready-made style or your own colors. Then click Save.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.body: See how the event page will look with your choices before saving.

locked.title: Read only
locked.body: Only admins can change these settings. You can still look at them.

texts.title: Page texts
texts.body: The title and introduction of the public Events page. Leave empty to keep the default text.

layout.title: Layout
layout.body: Choose how events are shown (grid or list) and how years are separated.

notes.title: Notes per year
notes.body: Add a short text under a year, for example to sum it up.

new.title: Create a form
new.body: Start from scratch or from a template: registration, survey, contact and more.

card.title: A form
card.body: Its status (draft, open, closed), the number of responses and new ones waiting for you.

actions.title: Edit, copy, reuse
actions.body: Edit the form, duplicate it, or save it as a template for next time.

templates.title: Your templates
templates.body: Forms you saved as templates. Start a new form from one in a click.

tabs.title: Build, share, read
tabs.body: Editor, Design, Share, Submissions, Integrations and Settings: the whole life of the form.

title.title: Title and description
title.body: What people see at the top of the form.

questions.title: Your questions
questions.body: Click a question to edit it. Drag to reorder, and mark it required if needed.

add.title: Add a question
add.body: Pick a type: short text, choices, date, file, rating… Shortcut: press / on your keyboard.

save.title: Saved automatically
save.body: Every change is saved by itself. This shows when it was last saved.

undo.title: Undo and redo
undo.body: Made a mistake? Go back a step (Ctrl+Z) or forward again.

preview.title: Try it
preview.body: See the form as visitors will, and test it without saving a response.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Open the form to the public when it's ready. You can close it again at any time.

controls.title: Look of the form
controls.body: Choose a style, colors, a cover image and a logo, then save.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.body: Your changes appear here right away.

link.title: Share the link
link.body: Copy the form's link to send it by message, email or social media.

qr.title: QR code
qr.body: Download a QR code for posters and flyers.

embed.title: Put it on a website
embed.body: Copy a code to show the form inside another web page.

views.title: Summary or responses
views.body: See charts per question, or read each response one by one.

filters.title: Search and sort
filters.body: Find a response by name or text and filter by status.

export.title: Download
export.body: Get every response as a CSV or Excel file.

google.title: Google Sheets
google.body: Connect a Google Sheet: every new response is added to it automatically.

how.title: How it works
how.body: A short explanation of what is sent and when.

main.title: Form settings
main.body: Title, link, opening and closing dates, response limits and messages.

danger.title: Careful zone
danger.body: Delete the form or its responses. This can't be undone.

account.title: Where files are stored
account.body: Photos and videos live in the club's Google Drive. The bar shows how much space is left.

changeAccount.title: Change the Google account
changeAccount.body: Only do this on purpose: files in the current account are hidden until it is connected again.

requests.title: Deletion requests
requests.body: Members can't delete. Their requests wait here: approve to delete, or reject.

newFolder.title: New folder
newFolder.body: Make one folder per event or topic to keep things tidy.

folder.title: A folder
folder.body: Open it to see, upload and download its photos and videos.

menuAdmin.title: Folder menu
menuAdmin.body: Rename the folder or delete it with everything inside (kept 30 days in the Drive trash).

menuMember.title: Folder menu
menuMember.body: Rename the folder, or ask an admin to delete it: deleting needs their approval.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Show only photos or videos, a shape (horizontal, vertical, square) or a video quality.

upload.title: Upload
upload.body: Choose files or drop them anywhere on the page. Big videos keep uploading while you browse.

file.title: A file
file.body: Click to open it in full size and download it. Tick the circle in the corner to select several files.

deleteAdmin.title: Selected files
deleteAdmin.body: With files selected, you can download, move them to another folder or delete them.

deleteMember.title: Selected files
deleteMember.body: With files selected, you can download or move them. Delete sends a request to an admin.

noYear.title: Open the year first
noYear.body: Finance starts with a year and the money the club has today. Then every purchase and income updates it.

google.title: Open or download
google.body: Open the year in Google Sheets or download it as an Excel file.

shareEmail.title: Your Google account
shareEmail.body: Google Sheets opens with this Gmail. Change it if you use another one.

yearActions.title: Manage the year
yearActions.body: Adjust the balance, close the year, or open the next one.

totals.title: Totals
totals.body: Money at the start, spent, received and what the club has now.

charts.title: Charts
charts.body: How the balance moved over the year, and where the money went or came from.

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.body: One sheet per event, training or type of purchase. Open one to add operations.

recent.title: Latest operations
recent.body: The last purchases and income added, in every sheet.

locked.title: Locked sheet
locked.body: This sheet is read only. Ask an admin if something must change.

add.title: Add an operation
add.body: Add a purchase (with several products if needed) or an income like a sponsor or fees.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Search, show only purchases or income, a category, or cancelled operations.

table.title: The operations
table.body: Every line with its date, amount and who added it. Totals of the lines shown are at the bottom.

quick.title: Quick add
quick.body: Type directly in this last row and press Enter to add a simple operation.

editMember.title: Fixing a mistake
editMember.body: You can change your own operations for 24 hours. After that, ask an admin.

editAdmin.title: Fixing a mistake
editAdmin.body: Double-click a row to edit it. As an admin you can change or cancel any operation.

export.title: Open or download
export.body: Open this sheet in Google Sheets, or download it as Excel or CSV.

list.title: Change history
list.body: Every creation, change and cancellation in finance: who did it, when, and what changed.

bureau.title: The bureau
bureau.body: President and vice president, shown at the top of the Team page.

departments.title: Departments
departments.body: Each department has a card and its own page. Drag to change the order.

new.title: New department
new.body: Add a department. It stays a draft until you publish it.

view.title: See the page
view.body: Open the public Team page in a new tab.

tabs.title: Four tabs
tabs.body: Details, Content, Design and Photos: each tab edits one part of the department page.

publish.title: Preview and publish
publish.body: Preview the page, then publish it so visitors can see it.

identity.title: Name and tagline
identity.body: How the department is named and introduced, in French and English.

leader.title: The leader
leader.body: Name, photo and role of the person in charge.

autosave.title: No Save button
autosave.body: Changes are saved automatically. This shows if everything is saved.

languages.title: French and English
languages.body: Write the page in French, then switch to English. An empty English page can be copied from the French one.

toolbar.title: Formatting tools
toolbar.body: Titles, bold, lists, links, images and more. The + button inserts blocks like photos or videos.

status.title: Saved automatically
status.body: Your text is saved as you type. This shows the word count and the last save.

controls.title: Colors and style
controls.body: Pick a ready-made style or your own colors. Saved automatically.

card.title: The card
card.body: How the department's card looks on the Team page.

preview.title: The page
preview.body: A preview of the department's own page.

mode.title: Team section
mode.body: Show one big team photo, one card per member, or both.

photos.title: Team photos
photos.body: Upload photos. The first one is shown large.

members.title: Members
members.body: Add each member with a name and photo, and reorder them.

pages.title: The site's pages
pages.body: Header and footer, the home page, and the Sponsors page. Open one to edit its texts and images.

brand.title: Logo and name
brand.body: Shown in the header and footer of every page.

nav.title: Menu
nav.body: The menu labels. If English is empty, the French text is used.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.body: Email, phone and address shown on the site and used by the contact buttons.

socials.title: Social links
socials.body: Links to the club's social media, shown in the footer.

save.title: Save
save.body: Nothing changes on the site until you save. Undo brings back the last saved version.

hero.title: The banner
hero.body: The big block at the top of the home page: titles, buttons and image.

stats.title: Key figures
stats.body: The club's numbers shown under the banner.

journey.title: The journey
journey.body: The club's story, step by step, as a timeline.

events.title: Events section
events.body: The title of the featured events block. Choose the events from the Events page.

save.title: Save
save.body: Nothing changes on the site until you save. Undo brings back the last saved version.

hero.title: Top of the page
hero.body: The title and introduction of the Sponsors page.

list.title: Sponsors
list.body: Add sponsors with their logo and link, and choose their order.

cta.title: Become a sponsor
cta.body: The block inviting new partners to contact the club.

save.title: Save
save.body: Nothing changes on the site until you save. Undo brings back the last saved version.

pending.title: New accounts
pending.body: People who signed up wait here. Activate them so they can use the admin.

role.title: Role and department
role.body: Admins can do everything. For a member, picking a department ticks its usual sections.

sections.title: Sections
sections.body: Tick exactly what a member can open: events, forms, media, finance.

status.title: Save or disable
status.body: Save the changes, or disable an account to block it. The last admin can't be removed.

disabled.title: Disabled accounts
disabled.body: Blocked accounts. Enable one to give access back.
